summary: This bill amends the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act to require drug makers to submit supply-chain reports up to four times per year that identify each supplier of active pharmaceutical ingredients and the amounts sourced from each, and to add original manufacturer names, facility identifiers, and supply-chain details to drug labels.
